notes.title: Coming soon! Before the release, the developer went to the Beijing Aquarium
notes.notes:
My friend, Hello !

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41421491/96a7275a434afaeac542d1c41a8b529c7ac04594.jpg

Maybe you still doubt whether you need to buy. Indeed, some people think this game is "lemon". But this game is worth playing!

Some friends said that such a game is insipid. I think this idea makes sense. Because the comparison of human players is basically not in this game; But in many places, this game has its settings not insipid.

Today, I went to the Beijing Aquarium. If you come to Beijing or you are in Beijing and you are interested in it, one way to get there is to take the subway and get off at the "Beijing Zoo Station". The ticket of the aquarium is about 180 RMB.  (I wore a mask, and follow the COVID prevention policy)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41421491/7194afa3ac2762f21cc646d100e20927900fa4f8.png

This aquarium is awesome ! Although it is a little old, you can see a lot of fish here! If you are still in the aquarium at about 15:00, you can see an animal show, which is watched by many children and their parents! (pay attention to the information released by Beijing Aquarium if you need.)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41421491/a2c84d22cb29bf1cda487e43277f62af9bdc8a1a.jpg

This is the fish you can see at the entrance!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41421491/649ac6489e951b6914b4defe262a73f23b613740.jpg

Many fish, there are many fish in it!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41421491/b1857ffea923b9f70c6b367836322bc58d3a45c6.jpg

And there are other marine life...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41421491/e5c38702ee002753a106c575459fa6878e7b159d.png

Well, our game has no content of aquarium and fish. But if you go to see the fish swimming... This is a complement to some of the plot in this game: -)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41421491/4dc5ee9d04839cc8e1c2d7bf0645c1386f798006.png

OK ! If you have money, I hope you go to buy this game I produced ! If you still have money after buying this game, you can also go to the Beijing Aquarium! Tickets only cost 180 RMB (about 29 U.S. dollar) ! A lot of children are there!

 Some parts of this game may be difficult, and many are not prompted. If you have difficulties, welcome to communicate with us! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41421491/35d50711abd4c34601633bb15eb8f1265c20104a.jpg

All in all, the Aquarium is awesome, this game is awesome, you're awesome, and please support a licensed copy!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41421491/4fb43294dcfc363a026fb6494961c9f594097c58.jpg
